title: Gradient Accumulation Bug — Effective batch size miscalculation
root_cause: When using gradient accumulation with mixed precision, loss scaling interacts with accumulation steps. Effective batch size = micro_batch * accumulation_steps * world_size, but some frameworks only account for two of three factors.
resolution_type: Invariant: effective_batch_size = micro * accum * world_size. Falsifiable by comparing gradient norms.
